$comment: Names whose word and property disagree, reviewed one at a time. Produced by
tools/review/name-truth.mjs and held by tests/name-truth.test.ts: a new disagreement fails the
build with the row to paste here, and a row that stops disagreeing fails it too.
banked      - the colour audit has already decided it (tests/roles.baseline.json)
by-equality - one quantity written to a neighbouring property on purpose, because the two are
the same length by construction: a gap realised with margins, an inset that is a
padding, a square whose width is a height
defect      - a rule that looks wrong and is left as found, named here so it is not invisible

rows.name: --dx-chat-file-base-section-gap
rows.why: A gap between the file name and the file size, realised with margins because the two are not flex children of one container. The word names the intent; there is no gap property to carry it here.

rows.name: --dx-context-menu-padding-inline
rows.why: Written to padding on the item, and to inset-inline-end on the popout arrow so the arrow sits exactly one padding in. The second is the first, by equality.

rows.name: --dx-date-view-roller-padding
rows.why: The roller’s vertical padding is realised with spacer pseudo-elements, so it is written to their height and to the selected frame’s top.

rows.name: --dx-diagram-selection-bg
rows.why: Already reviewed by the colour audit: fill is the SVG spelling of a background (roles.baseline.json, slotLies).

rows.name: --dx-drop-down-editor-invalid-badge-size
rows.why: The input reserves exactly the badge’s width, so the padding IS the size.

rows.name: --dx-file-uploader-file-wrapper-border-width
rows.why: The wrapper keeps its content clear of its own border by padding of the border’s width.

rows.name: --dx-gantt-content
rows.why: Already reviewed by the colour audit: one value painting the band and the marks that bound it (rule 5).

rows.name: --dx-grid-command-ai-button-max-width
rows.why: The button is pinned by left and right at its own width.

rows.name: --dx-grid-content-focused
rows.why: Already reviewed by the colour audit: the focus ring is an outline, and the name carries the content word from its family.

rows.name: --dx-invalid-badge-padding-inline
rows.why: The inset that centres the badge: it is the padding beside the badge, and the badge is positioned at that inset.

rows.name: --dx-list-item-height
rows.why: The select-all checkbox container is square: its width is the item’s height.

rows.name: --dx-list-item-padding-block
rows.why: Seventeen rules use it as the block half of the item’s padding, and one - .dx-list-item-chevron-container - writes it to padding-inline, where the item’s own -padding-inline is what belongs. Left as found: changing it moves the chevron, which is a decision for whoever owns the list, and this file is where it stops being invisible.

rows.name: --dx-menu-item-icon-gap
rows.why: The gap between a menu item’s icon and its text, realised with margin-inline on the icon and on the popout.

rows.name: --dx-scheduler-appointment-start-shadow
rows.why: Already reviewed by the colour audit: the start mark is drawn with an inset shadow in thirteen rules, and background-color is the fourteenth.

rows.name: --dx-scheduler-header-panel-margin
rows.why: The panel’s inline margin is realised as padding on the cell inside it.

rows.name: --dx-splitter-bar-border
rows.why: Already reviewed by the colour audit: a hairline drawn with a background.

rows.name: --dx-splitter-bar-border-disabled
rows.why: See splitter-bar-border.

rows.name: --dx-splitter-bar-border-width
rows.why: The splitter’s border is an element, not a border property, so its thickness is a width.

rows.name: --dx-tabs-item-padding-block
rows.why: The secondary indicator is offset by exactly the item’s block padding, so top carries it.

rows.name: --dx-text-editor-input-filled-padding-inline
rows.why: A filled input’s minimum width is its inline padding doubled, so the padding reaches min-width.

rows.name: --dx-text-editor-invalid-badge-size
rows.why: See drop-down-editor-invalid-badge-size.
